about: The model inspector's conventions (docs/design/model-inspector.md, section 2): which node names mark an attachment point (an empty) and what each needs, which mark a collision shape or a level of detail, the sizes a model may plausibly be, and how closely a catalog box, a collision shape and a level empty must match. Read by src/gui/model_view/inspect.rs and web/shared/model-inspect.js (the website and scripts/inspect-model.js). A new kind of empty is a new row here, never code. A node with no mesh is an empty when its name matches a row, or when it has no children; one with children and no matching name is a group. Names match case-insensitively on their start, after a Blender suffix like .001 is dropped. forward: outward (its +Z points away from the model's middle), level (its +Z lies flat and its +Y points up), any. size: the empty's scale is a size in metres (Space Engineers' detector and door dummies), between min_m and max_m on each axis.
